name: Stenograf
tagline: Private AI meeting notes that run on your computer
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunt, I’m Ivan, the maker of Stenograf. I built Stenograf because I wanted a private memory of my conversations: a way to find decisions, revisit commitments, and prepare for the next call while keeping the conversation on my computer. It captures your microphone and system audio without a bot joining the call. Transcription, summaries, and search run on your computer, and your recordings and complete transcripts stay local. You can identify follow-ups, prepare for an upcoming meeting
